thread:
lina (docs): Quick QA: the API ref for PATCH /v1/models/{model_id}/settings documents a field named `cpu_boost` (boolean) but the platform returns `cpu_boost_level` as an integer in runtime responses and accepts an int in the payload. This mismatch broke a customers' infra test.

rishi (eng-platform): Good catch. We changed the settings API during the autoscale work to allow levels (0-3) instead of a simple toggle. Docs never got updated.

lina (docs): Current docs example: 
```json
PATCH /v1/models/foo/settings
{
  "cpu_boost": true
}
```
But runtime expects something like:
```json
{
  "cpu_boost_level": 2
}
```
Do we keep the boolean alias for backwards compat or update the examples to the new name?

rishi (eng-platform): We kept a compatibility shim for incoming booleans for one release, but it's deprecated and will be removed next quarter. We should update docs to use `cpu_boost_level` and add a migration note.

alex (sdk): SDKs currently serialize `cpuBoost` in camelCase as boolean — I need to update both Node and Go to send `cpuBoostLevel` as an integer. Will add compatibility handling in the client for one release.

jas (qa): Found a failing test in infra smoke: the API mock expects `cpu_boost_level` but our sample fixtures still use `cpu_boost`. I'll update fixtures once docs decision is final.

lina (docs): Plan proposal: 1) Replace boolean examples with integer-level examples (0-3). 2) Add a short deprecation note: "cpu_boost (boolean) deprecated; use cpu_boost_level (integer)." 3) Add SDK migration snippet for Node/Python showing how to map old boolean to level. 4) Add changelog entry referencing runtime change.

rishi (eng-platform): Sounds good. We'll keep the shim for another minor release and include a server warning header so customers see deprecation in responses.

alex (sdk): I'll open PRs: JS/TS, Python, and Go. Example mapping I plan to include: 
```js
// legacy: cpuBoost: true -> cpuBoostLevel: 2
const cpuBoostLevel = typeof data.cpuBoost === 'boolean'
  ? (data.cpuBoost ? 2 : 0)
  : data.cpuBoostLevel;
```

lina (docs): Nice. Also can we add a small example in the API ref showing valid values and server-side implications (0 = default, 1 = burst, 2 = sustained, 3 = max)? Product input on wording pls.

rishi (eng-platform): Confirmed those semantics. Please use concise bullet list in docs.

jas (qa): I'll bump the fixture suite and add test cases for values 0 and 3 to catch edge cases.

ci-bot: build status: docs-pr/1748991111-model-settings-fieldname-update queued for lint + snippet checks.

lina (docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4927 — includes examples, migration snippet, and deprecation note. Requesting reviews from rishi and alex.

alex (sdk): Linking SDK PRs in docs PR comment. Will coordinate release tags so docs note the deprecation window.

rishi (eng-platform): Accepted changes. We'll add the deprecation-warning header this week.

lina (docs): Thanks — will merge after docs lint and SDK smoke tests pass. Will also add a short migration blurb to the settings migration guide.
